claims.claim: Added an explicitly invoked, read-only eligibility interface composing TASK-377 source binding with existing TASK-376/VP-02 validators, without an active admission caller.

The eligibility contract requires separately authenticated Human selection and exact mapping-review TASK, acceptance correspondence, immutable RUN, semantic sources, full PRIMARY Reviewer PASS and published-candidate lineage.
The Human-selection reader remains closed by default; absent or unavailable selection or review lineage yields NOT_ESTABLISHED without selecting a replacement TASK.

Checks reject unrelated review subjects, forged labels, conflicting pins, stale sources, changed approval refs, unsupported versions, incomplete acceptance and unrecognized lineage without permissive fallback.
Frozen results preserve separate source, review-authority, semantic-adequacy, Runtime-proof, applicability, future-version, G3/G6 and production-activation statuses.

Synthetic local Git tests include an independently pinned positive lineage and unrelated, missing, mismatched, stale, forged, oversized, moved-main and Git-write rejection scenarios. Local fixture sanity exercised positive binding, source-swap rejection, main movement, bounds and read-only guards.

Documentation distinguishes Human selection and mapping-specific independent review/publication from hashing, and preserves outstanding live mapping authority, operative admission, VP-01, L2/L3, G3/G6 and L4 work.
Only the four permitted files changed; no normal V1/V2 Runtime, Reviewer or Publisher mutation hook was added.
